Removes GPS location, camera details and other hidden data from your photos before you share them. Works entirely on your phone, with no internet access.

## Features

- **Strip & share.** Share any photo to "Strip & share" and the share sheet reopens with a clean copy.
- **Strip & share as file.** Sends the clean copy as a document, so WhatsApp and other chat apps don't compress it.
- **Choose what goes.** Location is always removed. Keep or remove camera details, date taken and rotation.
- **Look before you clean.** See every hidden detail in a photo, and afterwards what was removed and what was kept.
- **Find photos that give away where you were.** The gallery marks photos with a location so you can clean them all at once.
- **Save a copy or replace.** Replaced originals can go to the system Trash, restorable for 30 days.
- **Shortcuts.** Long-press the app icon to clean your latest photo or screenshot, or use the Quick Settings tile.
- Keeps full quality for JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC and AVIF.

## Fixes in this version

- Smoother transition when closing the results screen.
- Tidier spacing on the home screen.

## Download

Get **`exif-remover-v1.2.1.apk`**. Requires Android 11 or newer. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.
